newsitem.title: FRANCE: GEC Alsthom in Ukraine switchgear deal.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom in Ukraine switchgear deal.

text.p: GEC Alsthom said on Tuesday that its Power Transmission and Distribution Division won a contract to supply DnieproHydroEnergo with about 100 high voltage circuit breakers.
GEC Alsthom gave no financial details about the deal.
It said delivery of the breakers is scheduled to start in 1997 and will be completed by 1998.
It said the contract was part of Ukraine's programme to refurbish hydroelectric power plants along the Dniepr river.
The programme is part of a larger refurbishment plan, financed partly by the World Bank, and Canadian and Swiss government grants.
